draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.14, the 114th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 12th of 30 at LB. He went 80th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (114th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: James Smith-Williams. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (86th percentile). Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (2nd percentile), three-cone (8th percentile). College production: 39 tackles in 2022, 26th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 31 career games and 5 starts over 3 completed seasons.
